mission: Discover global radio through a calm geography-first experience.
rule: The world is the interface. One screen deserves one hero. Motion must have meaning.

intelligence_architecture.invariant: External intelligence may observe location claims, but material coordinates, boundaries, jurisdiction, proximity, routes and geocoding remain GeoAware-Core authority. Unverified spatial claims must remain degraded context.
intelligence_architecture.flow: Agent Reach observes -> GeoAware verifies WHERE -> OIC reasons/orchestrates -> WaveAtlas presents

design_principles: Geography-first discovery: location, place, and cultural context guide the experience.
Calm technology: systems should quietly support discovery without overwhelming the user.
One screen, one hero: each view should preserve a clear focal point.
Meaningful motion: movement must clarify state, orientation, or intent.
Restraint over novelty: avoid interface behavior that distracts from place-based understanding.

requires: GeoAware spatial verification for material location claims
quality_gate.description: Changes should preserve fast, accessible, restrained, coherent geography-first behavior while keeping GeoAware-Core authoritative for spatial truth and OIC authoritative for shared intelligence orchestration.
